title: Proper higher direct images retain finite constant scalar models
statement: Fix a prime ell, a field k of characteristic p0>0 different from ell, and separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y. Let p:X -> Y be a proper k-morphism. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring object equal as a bundled ring to the continuous-map condensed ring of a finite subextension E of Qbar_ell/Q_ell, or to the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic closure. Pull Lambda back to each scheme. For each finite constant-model constructible Lambda_X-module M and integer q>=0, H^q(Rp_*(M[0])) is finite constant-model constructible over Lambda_Y. Constructibility and derived pushforward are those of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] and [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

proof.text: Place M in degree zero. Its degree-zero cohomology is canonically isomorphic to M, and every other cohomology module is zero. Finite constant local models transport across isomorphisms. A zero module has the rank-zero constant presentation on the identity cover and hence a one-stratum constructible presentation, even on an empty scheme. Thus M[0] is bounded with finite-constant-model constructible cohomology.

Apply clause (4) of finiteCoefficientDescentTwoColimit on X and Y. In the standing positive-characteristic separated finite-type setting it explicitly identifies constantModelBoundedConstructible with boundedConstructible for E and the condensed algebraic closure. The bundled coefficient-ring equality allows transport with the ring operations fixed.

Convert CharP k p0 and p0>0 to the two ringChar facts, and regard p as a morphism over Spec k with its original structure maps. Convert the constructibility of M[0] using the equality on X; apply properPushforward_boundedConstructible_rational; convert back using the equality on Y. The resulting bounded constructibility contains finite-constant-model constructibility in each degree, so take degree q.

theorem properHeart_constructible_cohomology
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ : (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
      Mon.mk Λ = Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)) ∨
      Mon.mk Λ = Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ)
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] :
    ∀ M, IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X M → ∀ q : ℤ, 0 ≤ q →
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Y ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
